builds.title: Kir-Lanan ledge scout, racial Hit Dice only
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 8 (4 racial HD, LA +4).
traits: Neutral. Dexterity +3, natural armor +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 13. BAB +4, grapple +8. Fortitude +3, Reflex +7, Will +4.
Land 30 ft. and fly 90 ft. with good maneuverability, which allows hovering under 3.5 aerial movement.
Cure spells, holy water, and blessed weapons affect a Kir-Lanan as they would undead. Inflict spells and other negative energy heal it. A Kir-Lanan is a living creature and cannot be turned.

Soulless. Cannot use positive energy or divine magic or take levels in Cleric, Druid, or Paladin. Ranger levels grant no spellcasting. A Bard can learn inflict spells in place of cure spells. Return from death requires wish or miracle.
Weapon Focus adds +1 to claws. Flyby Attack lets Varek use one standard action during a flying move.
actions: Claw +9 melee, 1d4+4 piercing and slashing, critical ×2. Full attack with two claws at +9 each.

Touch +8 or claw +9 against normal AC, with Fortitude DC 13. Negative Energy Touch (Su), 3/day. Make a melee touch attack or deliver it with a claw that hits normal AC. Deals 2d6 damage and 1 point of Strength damage. Fortitude DC 12 + Charisma modifier negates the Strength damage only. Heal HP equal to the energy damage dealt, up to maximum HP.

Ray of Enfeeblement, ranged touch +7. Ray of Enfeeblement (Sp), 3/day at caster level 4. Ranged touch within 35 ft. The target takes a 1d6+2 Strength penalty for 4 minutes, to a minimum score of 1. No save. Spell resistance applies.
Rebuke or command undead 3/day as Cleric 4. Turning check 1d20+1, turning damage 2d6+5.
builds.tactics: Varek uses the ledge as cover to read the room before showing himself. If cornered, he keeps an open flight path and saves the touch for when he is injured.

builds.title: Kir-Lanan rookery guard, Fighter 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 4. ECL 10 (4 racial HD, 2 class HD, LA +4).
traits: Lawful neutral. Chain shirt +4, natural armor +3, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 17, armor check penalty −2. BAB +6, grapple +11. Fortitude +7, Reflex +6, Will +4.
Land 30 ft. and fly 90 ft. with good maneuverability, which allows hovering under 3.5 aerial movement.
Cure spells, holy water, and blessed weapons affect a Kir-Lanan as they would undead. Inflict spells and other negative energy heal it. A Kir-Lanan is a living creature and cannot be turned.

Soulless. Cannot use positive energy or divine magic or take levels in Cleric, Druid, or Paladin. Ranger levels grant no spellcasting. A Bard can learn inflict spells in place of cure spells. Return from death requires wish or miracle.
Flyby Attack and Stealthy are the racial feats. Weapon Focus (longsword) and Power Attack are Fighter bonus feats. Improved Initiative adds +4.
actions: Longsword +12 melee, 1d8+5 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Full attack with sword +12/+7 and one secondary claw +6, 1d4+2 piercing and slashing, critical ×2. Claw alone +11 for 1d4+5 piercing and slashing.

Touch +11 or claw +11 against normal AC, with Fortitude DC 12. Negative Energy Touch (Su), 3/day. Make a melee touch attack or deliver it with a claw that hits normal AC. Deals 2d6 damage and 1 point of Strength damage. Fortitude DC 12 + Charisma modifier negates the Strength damage only. Heal HP equal to the energy damage dealt, up to maximum HP.

Ray of Enfeeblement, ranged touch +8. Ray of Enfeeblement (Sp), 3/day at caster level 4. Ranged touch within 35 ft. The target takes a 1d6+2 Strength penalty for 4 minutes, to a minimum score of 1. No save. Spell resistance applies.
Rebuke or command undead 3/day as Cleric 6. Turning check 1d20, turning damage 2d6+6.
builds.tactics: Sira keeps the mouth of the rookery in sight. When she needs to hold the opening, she lands with her free claw facing the approach.

concepts.name: Varek Ashveil
concepts.motive: Find out who opened the abandoned watchtower before his wing arrives.
concepts.hook: Varek calls down from a shuttered ledge and offers a warning about the stairwell.

concepts.name: Sira Duskmere
concepts.motive: Keep the lower access clear while the rookery evacuates.
concepts.hook: Sira asks for a signal when the last evacuee reaches the open ledge.
